_meta.notes: Comprehensive index of all thematic clusters (Level 4) and sub-clusters (Level 5) for New Zealand / Aotearoa.

910.name: New Zealand's Geological Isolation
910.description: Zealandia separates from Gondwana; unique flora and fauna evolve in isolation for 80 million years.

sub_clusters.name: Separation from Gondwana
sub_clusters.description: Tectonic separation; development of unique biota including moa, kiwi, tuatara.

sub_clusters.name: Moa-Dominated Ecosystems
sub_clusters.description: Nine species of giant flightless birds; Haast's eagle apex predator.

920.name: Polynesian Settlement of Aotearoa
920.description: Polynesian navigators reach New Zealand; establishment of Māori culture.

sub_clusters.name: Great Waka Voyages
sub_clusters.description: Deliberate ocean voyaging from East Polynesia; founding canoe traditions.

sub_clusters.name: Archaic Māori Period (Moa Hunters)
sub_clusters.description: Moa hunting, early settlements, Wairau Bar site, adaptation to temperate climate.

sub_clusters.name: Moa Extinction
sub_clusters.description: Overhunting drives all moa species to extinction within 200 years.

920.name: Classic Māori Period
920.description: Complex tribal society, pā fortifications, carving, warfare, agriculture.

sub_clusters.name: Pā Fortifications
sub_clusters.description: Sophisticated hilltop forts with terraces, palisades, fighting platforms.

sub_clusters.name: Kūmara Agriculture
sub_clusters.description: Tropical crop adaptation to temperate climate; storage pits, garden systems.

sub_clusters.name: Māori Arts and Whakairo (Carving)
sub_clusters.description: Wood and bone carving, tā moko tattooing, weaving, haka traditions.

930.name: European Exploration of New Zealand
930.description: Dutch and British explorers encounter Aotearoa.

sub_clusters.name: Abel Tasman's Encounter
sub_clusters.description: First European sighting; violent encounter at Golden Bay; names it Staten Landt.

sub_clusters.name: James Cook's Voyages to New Zealand
sub_clusters.description: Circumnavigation, mapping, scientific observations, Queen Charlotte Sound base.

940.name: Early Contact Period
940.description: Whalers, sealers, missionaries, musket traders transform Māori society.

sub_clusters.name: Musket Wars
sub_clusters.description: Inter-tribal warfare intensified by European firearms; massive population displacement.

sub_clusters.name: Missionary Arrival
sub_clusters.description: Samuel Marsden, CMS mission at Rangihoua; literacy, Christianity, cultural change.

sub_clusters.name: Declaration of Independence of New Zealand
sub_clusters.description: He Whakaputanga; 34 northern chiefs assert sovereignty.

940.name: Treaty of Waitangi Era
940.description: Founding document of New Zealand; differing Māori and English texts; early colonial governance.

sub_clusters.name: Treaty of Waitangi Signing
sub_clusters.description: Signed at Waitangi 6 February 1840; sovereignty ceded vs. kawanatanga debate.

sub_clusters.name: New Zealand Company Settlements
sub_clusters.description: Wellington, Nelson, Canterbury, Otago planned colonies; Wakefield scheme.

sub_clusters.name: New Zealand Wars (1845–1872)
sub_clusters.description: Armed conflicts over sovereignty and land: Flagstaff War, Taranaki, Waikato, East Cape.

940.name: New Zealand Gold Rushes
940.description: Otago and West Coast gold discoveries; rapid population growth and economic transformation.

sub_clusters.name: Otago Gold Rush
sub_clusters.description: Gabriel's Gully; Dunedin becomes wealthiest NZ city.

sub_clusters.name: West Coast Gold Rush
sub_clusters.description: Hokitika port; Chinese miners; harsh conditions.

950.name: Liberal Era
950.description: World-leading social reforms; women's suffrage; old age pensions; labour laws.

sub_clusters.name: Women's Suffrage (1893)
sub_clusters.description: New Zealand becomes first self-governing country to grant women the vote.

sub_clusters.name: Land Reform and Closer Settlement
sub_clusters.description: Breaking up large estates, closer settlement schemes, state advances.

sub_clusters.name: Industrial Conciliation and Arbitration
sub_clusters.description: World's first compulsory arbitration system; minimum wages.

950.name: New Zealand in the World Wars
950.description: ANZAC legend; Gallipoli to Crete to El Alamein to the Pacific.

sub_clusters.name: Gallipoli (New Zealand)
sub_clusters.description: ANZAC Cove, Chunuk Bair; devastating casualties; national identity forged.

sub_clusters.name: New Zealand on the Western Front
sub_clusters.description: Somme, Messines, Passchendaele; highest per-capita casualties of any Allied nation.

sub_clusters.name: WWII New Zealand Campaigns
sub_clusters.description: Greece, Crete, North Africa, Italy, Pacific; 2nd NZEF.

sub_clusters.name: New Zealand Home Front (WWII)
sub_clusters.description: US Marines, manpower crisis, women in workforce, Japanese submarine threat.

950.name: Welfare State Era
950.description: First Labour Government builds cradle-to-grave welfare state.

sub_clusters.name: First Labour Government
sub_clusters.description: Social Security Act, state housing, public health, full employment.

sub_clusters.name: Post-War Prosperity
sub_clusters.description: Guaranteed British market; high living standards; state intervention.

960.name: Māori Renaissance
960.description: Cultural revival, land marches, Waitangi Tribunal, te reo revitalisation.

sub_clusters.name: Māori Land March (1975)
sub_clusters.description: Whina Cooper leads march from Te Hāpua to Wellington; 'Not one more acre'.

sub_clusters.name: Waitangi Tribunal
sub_clusters.description: Permanent commission investigates Treaty breaches; settlements reshape NZ.

sub_clusters.name: Kōhanga Reo Movement
sub_clusters.description: Māori language nests; immersion education; language revitalisation.

sub_clusters.name: Treaty Settlements Process
sub_clusters.description: Ngāi Tahu, Waikato-Tainui, and subsequent iwi settlements; redress and apology.

960.name: Rogernomics and Economic Reform
960.description: Radical free-market reform; deregulation, privatisation, restructuring.

sub_clusters.name: Fourth Labour Government Reforms
sub_clusters.description: Roger Douglas reforms; float NZ dollar, GST, SOEs, nuclear-free policy.

sub_clusters.name: Employment Contracts Act (1991)
sub_clusters.description: Bolger-Richardson labour market deregulation; union decline.

sub_clusters.name: MMP Introduction
sub_clusters.description: Mixed Member Proportional voting adopted by referendum; first MMP election 1996.

960.name: Nuclear-Free New Zealand
960.description: Anti-nuclear movement; ANZUS rift; nuclear-free zone legislation.

sub_clusters.name: Anti-Nuclear Movement
sub_clusters.description: French nuclear testing protests, Peace Squadron, mass marches.

sub_clusters.name: Rainbow Warrior Bombing
sub_clusters.description: French agents bomb Greenpeace ship in Auckland Harbour; international incident.

sub_clusters.name: New Zealand Nuclear Free Zone Act
sub_clusters.description: Bans nuclear weapons and nuclear-powered ships; ANZUS suspended.

960.name: Contemporary New Zealand
960.description: Clark to Ardern; social reform, earthquakes, Christchurch attacks, COVID response.

sub_clusters.name: Canterbury Earthquakes
sub_clusters.description: Devastating earthquakes; 185 deaths in February 2011; Christchurch rebuild.

sub_clusters.name: Christchurch Mosque Attacks
sub_clusters.description: Terrorist attack; 51 killed; rapid gun law reform; international response.

sub_clusters.name: Ardern Government
sub_clusters.description: Youngest female PM; COVID elimination strategy; wellbeing budget; global profile.

sub_clusters.name: COVID-19 Response
sub_clusters.description: Elimination strategy, hard lockdowns, MIQ, vaccination rollout, reopening.

unassigned_events.note: Events in events.json not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
